---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[BUG]"
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

**Bug Description**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Steps to Reproduce**
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll to '...'
4. Error occurs

**Expected Behavior**
What did you expect to happen instead?

**Actual Behavior**
What happens instead?

**Reproducibility**
- [ ] Always
- [ ] Sometimes
- [ ] Happened once

**Screenshots/Video**
If applicable, add screenshots or a short screen recording.

**Environment**
- Platform: [e.g. Web/PWA, Tauri Desktop App]
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, iOS 17]
- Browser (if Web/PWA): [e.g. Chrome 126, Safari 17]
- App Version: [e.g. v1.4.2]

**Severity**
- [ ] Critical – app/feature unusable
- [ ] High – core functionality affected
- [ ] Medium – works, but broken/ugly
- [ ] Low – cosmetic

**Additional Context**
Any other context, logs, or related issues that might help.
